lab.title: VLAN access và trunk qua hai switch
lab.objective: Create VLANs 10 and 20 on S1/S2. G0/1 is access VLAN 10, G0/2 is access VLAN 20, and G0/24 is the inter-switch trunk. PC1-PC2 in VLAN 10 and PC3-PC4 in VLAN 20 must communicate both ways. Different VLANs stay isolated; no inter-VLAN router is present. Save both switches. VLAN names and unused uncabled G0/3 assignment are optional.
limitations: Layer-2 access/trunk subset only; no HSRP, NAT, DHCP, native VLAN, allowed-VLAN pruning, or router subinterfaces.
